slices.focus: Second-round backup cohort + formal training binder launched
slices.summary: Lucia expands the backup effort with a second-round cohort mixing selected bilingual clerks and one outside contract interpreter, deliberately broadening the pool to reduce single-point-of-failure risk. She builds a formal training binder with front-loaded emergency procedures (who to call, what order, key scripts) and deeper reference sections (glossary, courtroom language, call trees). The binder is designed as 'backup coverage procedures' — an emergency operations tool with training sections, not a classroom notebook. She plans to test the binder with one clerk and one outside person separately, add an internal-operations vs. outside-backup insert, and fix the most confusing section (internal call procedures) before declaring it version one.
